description: Delivery: one feature branch and one pull request for the members below, built by one delegated session; the coordinating session opens no second PR, arms the PR, observes the merge and closes the tracker items. This is the feature-branch form of serial mode. A registered batch is not used because its members must be separate top-level sessions, and the owner asked for delegation to subagents. The members list this item in their needs so nobody claims them separately. Branch fix/pr-landing-guards. Starts only after pull requests #4110 and #4112 merge, because it changes the same files (scripts/pr_arm.py, make/pr-landing.mk, docs/agent/merge-authority.md). These members change the delivery loop itself, so the PR needs the soundness review and is never certified by a batch.
